summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, reporting its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing covers quarterly earnings, including total revenues of RMB23.0 billion, deliveries of 95,142 vehicles, and a net loss of RMB2.3 billion. No event-driven corporate action (merger, acquisition, spin-off, etc.) is described. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
